metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe goes over how to get rid of a pain in the groin with easy AT HOME stretches that can give groin pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

They don't require any special equipment, are straight-forward, can can give QUICK groin and inner leg pain relief.

They're going to focus on stretching the muscle group in the inner leg known as the adductors. These muscles are commonly strained from overuse, such as from squatting at the gym, or doing an activity your body isn't quite ready for.

So we're focusing on loosening up those muscles in and around the groin with SAFE, natural movements --that way you'll also have more mobility and less overall stiffness on top of less pain. 

If you're experiencing pain around the groin, this is one you'll not want to miss. WATCH NOW and see the best exercise for groin pain relief!
